# Copilot instructions

All agent instructions for this repository live in `AGENTS.md` files. Follow them, and don't add rules here.

- [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root applies everywhere.
- Scoped files add rules for their folder:
  - [`src/aikit/AGENTS.md`](../src/aikit/AGENTS.md)
  - [`src/aikit/components/AGENTS.md`](../src/aikit/components/AGENTS.md)
  - [`project/AGENTS.md`](../project/AGENTS.md)
  - [`tests/AGENTS.md`](../tests/AGENTS.md)
